content.short: MetaTrust Labs is a global Web3 AI security provider incubated by Nanyang Technological University.
content.description: MetaTrust Labs delivers AI-powered Web3 security solutions that extend beyond smart contract audits. Our technology empowers developers, exchanges, and projects to safeguard smart contracts across the entire development lifecycle. With a dedicated Security Operations Center (SOC) solution, teams monitor, assess, and respond to security risks from design to deployment across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Avalanche, ZKSync, Starknet, Polygon zkEVM, OP Mainnet, Polygon, Cronos, Aptos, Multichain. By anticipating evolving threats, MetaTrust Labs helps the Web3 ecosystem build more secure applications.
